evidence.description: REQ-03 客户上线：承保结论查询（只读 t_client_underwriting）
evidence.lastCheckMessage: 连接与只读权限检查通过

checks.check: 模板试跑 DEMO-CL-001（不落库，单行）

evidence.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN t.tier IS NULL OR t.tier = 'RESTRICTED' THEN 0 WHEN ? = 'OBSERVATION' AND t.tier IN ('OBSERVATION', 'STANDARD') THEN 1 WHEN ? = 'STANDARD' AND t.tier = 'STANDARD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS satisfied, t.tier AS out_tier, IF(t.tier = 'OBSERVATION' AND t.observation_started_time IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, t.observation_started_time, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) >= t.observation_target_days, 1, 0) AS out_observationDue, CASE WHEN t.tier IS NULL THEN 'LIMIT_TIER_NOT_SET' WHEN t.tier = 'RESTRICTED' THEN 'LIMIT_TIER_RESTRICTED' WHEN (? = 'OBSERVATION' AND t.tier IN ('OBSERVATION', 'STANDARD')) OR (? = 'STANDARD' AND t.tier = 'STANDARD') THEN NULL ELSE 'LIMIT_TIER_BELOW_TARGET' END AS missing FROM (SELECT 1 AS anchor) anchor LEFT JOIN t_client_limit_tier t ON t.client_id = ? LIMIT 2
